Any future entry: risk ≤1% of account, stop at confirmed swing low or 1.5–2x ATR, minimum 2:1 target at nearest resistance. Reject any proposal above 3% account risk. Re-evaluate within one trading cycle.
risk_controls.stop_loss: Not applicable while flat; future stop at confirmed swing low or 1.5–2x ATR once price data is supplied
risk_controls.take_profit: None assigned until a BUY trigger is met; minimum 2:1 reward/risk to nearest resistance
risk_controls.invalidation: Any HOLD-to-BUY thesis is invalidated by a decisive support break on rising volume, or by a bearish claim with numeric support above 0.5 and contradiction below 0.3.
risk_controls.max_position_size: 0 (flat) until BUY triggers are met; then ≤1% account risk

final_trade_intent.rationale_summary: The evidence is mixed and largely data-gap: bull 0.40 vs bear 0.41, contradiction 0.16, quant 0.02. Bullish claims (macro_002, sentiment_002) have near-zero numeric support, and the bearish market_001 is a missing-technicals claim, not evidence of breakdown. Open contradictions (market_001 vs sentiment_002 at 0.66; macro_002 vs market_001 at 0.56) remain unresolved. Without verified 1h/4h/1d structure, ATR, or a 2:1 reward/risk setup, a BUY would rest on the CUDA narrative alone. Under elevated uncertainty and with no open position, staying flat preserves capital.
